context: Aunt Naoko is teaching Sakura how to make a real curry from scratch on a quiet Sunday.
purpose: aunt-niece transmission of practical skill — gentle empowerment through cooking

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、まず玉ねぎから切ろう。
lines.en: Sakura-chan, first let's cut the onion.
lines.style: Aunt warm teaching brightness, the cooking-class voice opening up, soft real care threading through the instruction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい！玉ねぎ、目に染みるから苦手。
lines.en: Yes! Onion stings my eyes, so I don't like it.
lines.style: Teen warm honest sharing with the small complaint folded in, real comfortable familiarity audible throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、コツがあるよ。よく冷やすの。
lines.en: Hehe, there's a trick. Chill it well.
lines.style: Aunt warm conspiratorial laugh, the small kitchen-wisdom shared with delight, soft real teaching pleasure throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: え、そんなのあるんだ。知らなかった。
lines.en: Eh, there's such a thing? I didn't know.
lines.style: Teen surprised real interest lifting, voice lifting with genuine learning energy, soft warm curiosity throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 料理は、ちょっとした工夫で楽になる。
lines.en: Cooking gets easier with small clever tricks.
lines.style: Aunt gentle wisdom-sharing, the practical philosophy held in warm steady delivery, soft real teaching weight throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほどー。次は何を入れるの？
lines.en: I see. What goes in next?
lines.style: Teen attentive following voice, the engagement audible in the cooking-class participation, soft warm curiosity throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: にんじんとじゃがいも。大きめに切ってね。
lines.en: Carrot and potato. Cut them on the bigger side.
lines.style: Aunt warm continuing teaching, the precise instruction softened by the casual cadence, soft real guidance throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: これくらい？大きすぎる？
lines.style: Teen careful checking voice, the gentle uncertainty audible, soft real wanting-to-do-it-right energy throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ちょうどいい。上手じゃない！
lines.en: Just right. You're good at this!
lines.style: Aunt warm praise lifting bright, the real recognition unforced, soft genuine affirmation threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えへへ、嬉しい。本当に習いたかったの。
lines.en: Heehee, I'm happy. I really wanted to learn this.
lines.style: Teen warm pleased disclosure, the soft real confession of wanting threaded through the laugh, gentle joy throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: いつでも教えるよ。一緒に作るのは楽しいから。
lines.en: I'll teach you anytime. Cooking together is fun.
lines.style: Aunt warm generous offer, the genuine pleasure in the shared activity audible, soft real care throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: How do you do the seasoning?
lines.style: Teen practical curiosity moving forward, the engagement deepening with each step, soft warm interest throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ルーを入れて、よく混ぜる。それだけ。
lines.en: Add the roux and mix well. That's all.
lines.style: Aunt warm simple instruction, the practical secret revealed plainly, soft confidence threading through the delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: これ、いつか自分で作れるようになりたい。
lines.en: I want to be able to make this on my own someday.
lines.style: Teen genuine aspirational voice, the real wanting carried in the warm honest delivery, soft sincere intent throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: きっとできる。何回か作ったら、絶対できるよ。
lines.en: You'll definitely manage. After making it a few times, you'll absolutely get it.
lines.style: Aunt warm confident reassurance, the steady belief in her niece audible, soft real conviction threading throughout delivery.
